published_basis.paper: Shaojun Zhang, Dissecting Currency Momentum, JFE 2022
published_basis.rule: long a currency factor after a positive one-month factor return and short it after a negative return

rebalance.target: first Monday of each calendar month at 10:05 broker-server time
rebalance.exit: close prior cohort before opening the new cohort
rebalance.final_cohort: must close at the next frozen rebalance before dataset end

formation.recent: exact H1 close at 09:00 on current rebalance Monday
formation.anchor: exact H1 close at 09:00 on the preceding calendar month's first Monday
formation.dollar_factor_return: equal-weight arithmetic mean of all seven foreign-currency log returns

direction.direct_mapping: foreign BUY=pair BUY, foreign SELL=pair SELL
direction.inverse_mapping: foreign BUY=pair SELL, foreign SELL=pair BUY

costs.swap: frozen V26 FP Markets symbol specification

prohibited: sealed OOS before all gates pass
